title: Mirror construction of Hecke correspondence between Nakajima quiver varieties
summary: Nakajima constructed geometric representations of a deformed Kac-Moody Lie algebra using Hecke correspondences between quiver varieties. In this paper, we show that Hecke correspondences, which are holomorphic Lagrangians in products of Nakajima quiver varieties, can be obtained by applying the localized mirror construction to the morphism spaces between families of framed Lagrangian branes supported on the core of a plumbing of two-spheres. Moreover, for a non-ADE quiver, we show that the localized mirror functor is fully-faithful.
